title: BPMN4CAI: A BPMN Extension for Modeling Dynamic Conversational AI
abstract: arXiv:2608.27149v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Conversational AI systems, such as chatbots and virtual assistants, are becoming increasingly important to digital business processes. However, the established Business Process Model and Notation (BPMN) standard faces challenges when representing dynamic, context-sensitive interactions. This paper addresses this methodological and practical research gap by developing a standard-compliant BPMN extension (BPMN4CAI). Using Design Science Research methodology, this paper develops an approach that systematically extends existing BPMN elements and incorporates specialized components. The applicability and relevance of the BPMN4CAI framework are demonstrated and evaluated through a case study. The results show that the BPMN4CAI extension facilitates adaptive decision-making processes, robust context management, and transparent interactions for Conversational AI within business processes.

translated_title: BPMN4CAI：一种用于建模动态对话式AI的BPMN扩展
translated_abstract: 对话式AI系统，如聊天机器人和虚拟助手，正变得越来越重要于数字业务流程。然而，成熟的业务流程模型与标注（BPMN）标准在表示动态、上下文敏感的交互时面临挑战。本文通过开发一种符合标准的BPMN扩展（BPMN4CAI），解决了这一方法论和实践研究空白。采用设计科学研究方法，本文提出了一种系统扩展现有BPMN元素并整合专用组件的方法。通过案例研究，展示了BPMN4CAI框架的适用性和相关性，并进行了评估。结果表明，BPMN4CAI扩展促进了业务流程中对话式AI的自适应决策过程、稳健的上下文管理和透明的交互。
tldr: 本文提出BPMN4CAI扩展，通过设计科学研究方法系统扩展BPMN标准，以支持业务流程中对话式AI的动态交互和上下文管理。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the BPMN4CAI extension, systematically extending the BPMN standard via design science research to support dynamic interactions and context management of conversational AI in business processes.
